description: This file defines a Flutter widget for a dashboard tab in a fitness app, displaying daily and weekly metrics such as steps and calories, including charts and summary cards.

classes.name: DashboardTab
classes.description: Main widget representing the dashboard tab with a stateful implementation.

classes.name: _DashboardTabState
classes.description: State class managing the loading and display of dashboard data within the DashboardTab.

classes.name: _DailyAndWeeklyCards
classes.description: Widget displaying today's steps and calories along with weekly totals.

classes.name: _StatCard
classes.description: Reusable card widget showing a statistic with an icon.

classes.name: _ProgressChart
classes.description: Widget rendering a bar chart representing daily metrics.

classes.name: _PlaceholderPanel
classes.description: Placeholder widget for the progress chart section.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for DashboardTab widget.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Initializes data loading when dependencies change.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the dashboard tab.

methods.name: _DailyAndWeeklyCards.build
methods.description: Builds the row of statistics cards for today and the week.

methods.name: _StatCard.build
methods.description: Constructs a statistic display card with icon, title, and value.

methods.name: _ProgressChart.build
methods.description: Builds a bar chart of daily steps metrics.

methods.name: _PlaceholderPanel.build
methods.description: Builds the placeholder container for future chart content.
